lines.japanese: その後、一時間目と二時間目のあいだに、佐久間君が私服のまま戻ってきました。
lines.english: Later, between first and second period, Sakuma returned, still wearing his street clothes.

lines.japanese: もう一度先輩のことを問いなおしてみたのですが、やっぱり答えは同じで、羽田先輩は私のことなど存じておられなかったというのです。
lines.english: I asked him about Haneda again, but his answer remained the same: Haneda had claimed not to know me.

lines.japanese: しかしそう語る彼の言葉には、ところどころ理解しがたい奇声や絶叫が雑じるので、いまひとつ要領を得ません。
lines.english: However, Sakuma’s account was so liberally interspersed with incomprehensible shrieks and howls that I could not make much sense of it.

lines.japanese: これは逆に考えれば、羽田先輩も佐久間君の特異な日本語を理解しきれず、誤った回答をしたとも推測できます。
lines.english: Looked at another way, perhaps Haneda had not fully understood Sakuma’s peculiar way of speaking either, and had given the wrong answer.

lines.japanese: だから私は、先輩が私のことを知らなかったなんて嘘だいと思うことにして、ふたたび朝イチの幸せ感覚を取りもどしたのでした。
lines.english: And so I decided it simply could not be true that Haneda did not know me, and recovered the happiness I had felt first thing that morning.

lines.japanese: 「しゃーわせー……」
lines.english: “So haaappy...”

lines.japanese: そして放課後。
lines.english: Then came the end of the school day.

lines.japanese: 今日の茶道部は、いつもと違う場所に集まっていました。
lines.english: The tea-ceremony club was meeting in an unusual location today.

lines.japanese: 顧問不在の日は部室を使えない、という決まりが最近できた（お姉さま方の活動内容があまりに自由すぎたせいです）ので、岡村部長の在籍する３Ａ教室をお借りしていたのです。
lines.english: A recent rule prohibited us from using our clubroom when our advisor was absent—the older girls had been far too free with the nature of their activities—so we had borrowed the Class 3-A classroom, where our president, Okamura, belonged.

lines.japanese: 「ハァー、やっぱ部室じゃないと、いまいちノらないよねー」
lines.english: “Sigh. It’s just not the same outside the clubroom.”

lines.japanese: 「なー？　畳じゃねえとマジたるいわ」
lines.english: “Right? Without the tatami, everything’s a drag.”

lines.japanese: 先輩方には不評のようでしたが、しかし私は代理教室大歓迎でした。
lines.english: The older girls were displeased, but I welcomed the substitute classroom with open arms.

lines.japanese: 何故なら、そう、三年Ａ組と言えば──
lines.english: Because Class 3-A was, of course—

lines.japanese: 「はねだせんぱいー」
lines.english: “Haaaneeedaaa...”

lines.japanese: ──のいらっしゃるクラスだからです。
lines.english: —Haneda’s class.

lines.japanese: もしかしたら机の隅に「毎朝電車で会う女の子が気になる」くらいの落書きがあるかもしれません。ありませんでしたけど。
lines.english: Perhaps one corner of his desk would bear a message such as, “I can’t stop thinking about the girl I see on the train every morning.” It did not.

lines.japanese: しかし、こうして羽田先輩の席に座っているだけで、頭がぽやーんとして得も言われぬ多幸感に包まれてしまいます。
lines.english: But simply sitting at Haneda’s desk made my thoughts grow soft and hazy, enveloping me in indescribable bliss.

lines.japanese: 「はぁ～、先輩ったら、なんて硬くて頼もしい胸板……」
lines.english: “Oh, Haneda... What a firm, reliable chest you have...”

lines.japanese: 「林田ー」
lines.english: “Hayashida.”

lines.japanese: 空想しながら頬ずりしていた私を、高内先輩が呼んでいました。
lines.english: Takauchi was calling to me as I rubbed my cheek against the desk, lost in fantasy.

lines.japanese: 「あっ、はい、なんでしょう」
lines.english: “Oh! Yes? What is it?”

lines.japanese: あわてて体を起こして、お姉さま方の輪に向かいました。
lines.english: I sat up in a hurry and joined the circle of older girls.

lines.japanese: 「おー、ちょっとそこ座って、話加わってよ」
lines.english: “Hey, come sit down and get in on this.”

lines.japanese: 「話ですか？」
lines.english: “On what?”

lines.japanese: なんでしょう。もしかして、いま私が座っていた机の主が、毎朝電車で会う女の子が気になるなどと言っていたなんて嬉しい情報でしょうか。
lines.english: What could it be? Perhaps they had wonderful news that the owner of the desk where I had been sitting could not stop thinking about a girl he saw on the train every morning.

lines.japanese: 「あんさー、いま『萌えー』ってやつについて話しあっててー」
lines.english: “See, we’re talkin’ about this whole ‘melts your heart’ thing...”

lines.japanese: 「マチャコやべえよ、すっかり恋する乙女だもんな」
lines.english: “Machako’s got it bad. She’s a maiden in love now.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょ、マジそーゆんじゃねンだって。萌えーってやつは、この先オンナの必須科目なんだって。大学行っても必要になるんだって」
lines.english: “Hey, it’s seriously not like that. Melting hearts is gonna be required study for girls from now on. We’ll need it in college too.”
“I see...”

lines.japanese: どうやら先輩方は恋の話をされていたようです。
lines.english: The older girls appeared to be discussing romance.

lines.japanese: そこに私を呼んだということは、つまり……私に恋の相談？
lines.english: And if they had called me over, that meant... they wanted my romantic counsel?

lines.japanese: ふむふむ、たしかにこの林田美咲、こと片想いに関してはすでにベテランの域です。片想うことにかけては、ちょっと腕に覚えがあります。片恋初心者への指導を乞われれば、助力するのもやぶさかではありません。
lines.english: Indeed, Misaki Hayashida was already a veteran of unrequited love. When it came to pining, I knew my craft. If beginners in the art sought my guidance, I would not begrudge them my assistance.

lines.japanese: 「でさぁ、この場合やっぱ、カッケーのはナシじゃね？　って話でぇ」
lines.english: “So anyway, we were saying that cool stuff probably won’t work here.”

lines.japanese: 「だよね林田？　キホン女ウケすんのは違うよね」
lines.english: “Right, Hayashida? What girls usually like is the wrong way to go, yeah?”

lines.japanese: 「え？　なにがです？」
lines.english: “What are we talking about?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、だから、男はどんなパンツが好きなのかっつー話。セージュン派のおまえはどんなパンツ穿いてンのよ」
lines.english: “Panties. What kinda panties do guys like? You’re our pure little maiden—what’re you wearing?”

lines.japanese: 「ぱ、ぱんつですか？　えっ、いえ、べつに──」
lines.english: “P-panties? Um, nothing special—”
“Just... normal...”

lines.japanese: 「あァ、こーゆーんか」
lines.english: “Oh, like these?”
“...What?”

lines.japanese: 「どーせ白かと思ったけど、こんなンもアリなんだ」
lines.english: “I figured they’d be white, but these work too.”

lines.japanese: 「でもカワイイ系じゃん、やっぱこーゆーノリなんだよ」
lines.english: “They’re still cute. Yeah, this is definitely the right vibe.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あの……ななな何を……」
lines.english: “Um... Wh-wh-what are you...”

lines.japanese: 先輩方の声が、どこか遠い場所での会話みたいに聞こえました。
lines.english: The older girls’ voices sounded as though they were speaking somewhere far away.

lines.japanese: 私はいま何をされたのでしょう。何をされているのでしょう。
lines.english: What had they just done to me? What were they doing to me?

lines.japanese: 上級生のお姉さま方が、私を取りかこんで一点を凝視しています。
lines.english: The older girls surrounded me, staring intently at a single point.

lines.japanese: 「や、でも、ウチらの歳でコレはねーだろ。いくらオトコは萌えンのが好きッつったって、流石に引かれるだろ、こんなん見せたら」
lines.english: “Yeah, but we’re way too old for these. Guys may like having their hearts melted, but show ’em something like this and they’ll run.”

lines.japanese: みみみ見せません、誰にも見せません。
lines.english: I-I-I would not show them. I would never show them to anyone.

lines.japanese: 「そりゃウチらは引くけどさー、結局ソレは女視点じゃん。その発想が邪魔なんだって」
lines.english: “Sure, we’d run, but that’s still a girl’s point of view. That thinking’s what gets in the way.”

lines.japanese: 「あーそっかー、むじィなー萌え」
lines.english: “Oh, right. Melting hearts is complicated.”

lines.japanese: 「つか、ナンダコノ模様。いい歳してありえねっつの。どこで売ってん？　ブランドどこよ？」
lines.english: “Seriously, what is this pattern? You’re too old for this shit. Where do they even sell these? What brand?”

lines.japanese: 「ひゃあああっ！」
lines.english: “Eeeee!”

lines.japanese: 高内先輩の親指が下着の縁へ掛かったので、いよいよ私は先輩方を押しのけて飛びのきました。
lines.english: When Takauchi hooked her thumb under the edge of my underwear, I finally shoved the older girls aside and leaped away.

lines.japanese: 「ちょ、バカ暴れんな、タグ見せろって」
lines.english: “Hey, quit thrashing around! I just wanna see the tag.”

lines.japanese: 「いやあああ、ごめんなさい許してくださいいいい」
lines.english: “Noooo! I’m sorry! Please forgive me!”

lines.japanese: タグなんてありませんんん。モンキの二枚１０００円ですううう。
lines.english: There is no tag! They were two pairs for a thousand yen at Monki!

lines.japanese: 「あー、コレかぁ。この嫌がり方が萌えーってやつかぁ」
lines.english: “Ohhh, I get it. This whole squealing-and-resisting thing melts their hearts.”

lines.japanese: 「あんだよ林田！　てめ、ケツ剥かれたぐれーでピーピー泣いてんじゃねえよ、このケツ！　手形付くまで引っぱたくぞ、このドケツ！」
lines.english: “What the hell, Hayashida?! Quit bawling just ’cause somebody flashed your ass, dumbass! I’ll smack it till my handprint sticks, you goddamn ass!”

lines.japanese: 「あー、コレはやっぱチャコには無理だわ……」
lines.english: “Yeah, there’s no way Chako can pull that off...”
